item.title: Verstappen to become first Formula 1 driver to change ‘Competition Number’ | Formula 1
item.description: Max Verstappen cannot race with the number one next year but will not switch back to 33 as he has chosen to make a change.

item.description: Also in Friday's edition of the RaceFans round-up, the famed Dunlop bridge at the Circuit de la Sarthe will be rebranded after over 100 years.

item.title: Was that Stroll’s best or worst season yet alongside Alonso? | 2025 F1 team mates head-to-head
item.description: Lance Stroll achieved his best points share against Fernando Alonso since they became team mate, despite being thrashed in qualifying.

item.title: Alpine keep the faith in Colapinto but was he clearly more competitive than Doohan? | 2025 F1 team mates head-to-head
item.description: Franco Colapinto earned himself a full season at Alpine last year but neither he nor predecessor Jack Doohan scored points for Alpine.

item.title: FIA confirms 2026 F1 entry list with Lindblad reviving number last raced in 1980 | Formula 1
item.description: The official entry list for the 2026 Formula 1 season reveals Arvid Lindblad will use a number which hasn't appeared in a race for 45 years.

item.title: Stewards gain new powers to change penalty calls in 2026 | Formula 1
item.description: Formula 1 stewards will have new powers to review their decisions in 2026 if previously unavailable evidence emerges.

item.description: Also in Saturday's edition of the RaceFans round-up, Williams reveal their special livery for pre-season testing.

item.title: Caption Competition 282: Alonso’s word with the championship contenders | Caption Competition
item.description: Fernando Alonso had a word with the three championship contenders ahead of the season finale in Yas Marina. Join in our final Caption Competition of 2025.

item.title: The Formula 2 team with an older driver line-up than almost half the F1 grid | Formula 2
item.description: With a pair of drivers in their mid-twenties, Formula 2 team Hitech's line-up for 2026 is older than that of five Formula 1 teams.
